sentences: I have a headache.
عندي صداع.
My stomach hurts.
معدتي تؤلمني.
You should see a doctor.
ينبغي أن تذهب إلى الطبيب.
You shouldn't drink cold water.
لا ينبغي أن تشرب ماءً باردًا.
I'd like to make an appointment, please.
أود أن أحجز موعدًا من فضلك.
Could you speak more slowly, please?
هل يمكنك أن تتكلم ببطء أكثر من فضلك؟
Excuse me, I'm lost. Could you help me?
لو سمحت، أنا تائه. هل يمكنك مساعدتي؟
A return ticket to Aswan, please.
تذكرة ذهاب وعودة إلى أسوان من فضلك.
What time does the train arrive?
متى يصل القطار؟
Thank you so much. — You're welcome!
شكرًا جزيلًا. — العفو!

grammar.intro_ar: بعد should و could و may يأتي الفعل بدون to وبدون s: He should rest (وليس should to rest).

rows: You should rest. You shouldn't smoke.
Take this medicine. Don't eat fast food.
Could you open the door, please? May I sit here?

exercises.title: Exercise 1 · Complete with should or shouldn't.
items: 1) You have a fever. You ___ go to work.
2) He has a toothache. He ___ see a dentist.
4) You have a cough. You ___ smoke.
5) She's lost. She ___ ask a police officer.
6) You ___ eat a lot of sugar.

exercises.title: Exercise 3 · Put the conversation at the doctor's in order.
exercises.instructions: Put the conversation at the doctor's in order.
items: 3) c) I have a fever and a bad cough.
4) d) Take this medicine three times a day, and you should rest.
6) f) Good morning. Please sit down.

exercises.title: Exercise 4 · Translate into English.
items: 2) ينبغي أن تشرب الكثير من الماء.
